description: Definição formal das 6 classes de autoridade, níveis de precedência e regras de arbitragem para a governança do repositório Accelerate.

governing-authority.meaning: Repo-local source that directly governs Accelerate behavior.
governing-authority.scope_rule: Highest authority within repository boundary. Overrules all lower classes.

decision-artifact.meaning: A specific plan, packet, review, ADR, or task ledger accepted for a run.
decision-artifact.scope_rule: Decides behavior for the bounded run and only under root laws and governing authority.

backend-authority.meaning: State read from the active workflow/runtime backend through an implemented adapter.
backend-authority.scope_rule: Authoritative only through an implemented, selected adapter and only for backend facts it owns.

supporting-reference.meaning: Inherited or comparative material that informs but does not override native authority.
supporting-reference.scope_rule: Informs, explains, compares, or provides depth; cannot override root laws, native core docs, or accepted decisions.

generated-export.meaning: Outward runtime host material generated from this repository.
generated-export.scope_rule: Deployment products downstream of repository validation. Reverse edge (export -> source) is strictly forbidden.

forbidden-authority.meaning: Any source that must not govern this repository unless imported, adapted, registered, and enforced here first.
forbidden-authority.scope_rule: Strictly prohibited as source of truth. Denies advancement closed.

enforcement_rules.description: Native repo authority wins over inherited references or external sources when covering the same surface.
Generated exports are downstream deployment outputs; treating an export as canonical authority violates the reverse edge invariant.
Supporting references cannot overrule root laws, native core docs, or accepted decision artifacts.
Backend authority is valid only through an implemented adapter and only for facts that backend owns.
User-home catalogs, external catalogs, and stale global mirrors are strictly rejected without local import and registration.
